svg.title: DM100 Orbital RTLS Trajectory with Split Dynamic Pressure and Throttle Profiles
svg.desc: Calm baseline vs. complex weather 2D recovery trajectory with independent dynamic pressure (ascent 29.4 kPa, entry 25.2 kPa, both well below 42 kPa limit and 33.6 kPa 80% margin) and main engine throttle (3 restarts, 92 s unpowered grid fin glide) panels.
svg.text: Calm baseline (solid) vs. weather (dashed) · Dynamic pressure (top) and throttle (bottom) on separate axes
Stage 1 Trajectory (Alt km vs Downrange km)
Generated from 50 Hz recorded calm and complex weather replay telemetry; both dynamic pressure peaks remain below the 33.6 kPa (80%) margin.
